title: Will Edge continue to support Airbitz?
description: Edge has ceased support of Airbitz. Users will need to download Edge (www.edge.app) and use their full username and password to gain acces...
body:
Edge has ceased support of Airbitz. Users will need to download Edge (www.edge.app) and use their full username and password to gain access to their account. If you run into any issues or concerns please reach out to our support team at support@edge.app.

Note you will need your full username and password, pin will not work until after your first log in.
